name: AURE-CERA 3 Ceramide Complex
description: A biomimetic lipid complex designed to support barrier-focused emulsions with ceramide NP, cholesterol and complementary fatty components in a formulator-friendly concentrate.
applications: Barrier creams, facial emulsions, body lotions, masks and post-treatment care concepts. Confirm compatibility and final use level in the finished formulation.

name: AURE-HA Multi-Molecular Hyaluronate
description: A balanced sodium hyaluronate blend combining complementary molecular-weight fractions for immediate slip, film formation and layered hydration concepts.
applications: Serums, essences, gels, masks, creams and leave-on hair or scalp products. Pre-disperse as needed and validate viscosity in the final system.

name: AURE-NIA 99 Niacinamide
description: High-purity cosmetic niacinamide for tone-evening, barrier-support and sebum-care formulations requiring reliable dissolution and tight quality control.
applications: Brightening serums, moisturizers, body care, scalp treatments and oil-control products. Verify pH, stability and local claim requirements in the final formula.

name: AURE-CICA Centella Extract
description: A water-based Centella asiatica extract standardized for a consistent botanical profile and designed for calming, recovery and sensitive-skin concepts.
specs: Appearance: pale green to amber liquid
applications: Toners, essences, soothing gels, emulsions, masks, scalp care and after-sun concepts. Add during cool-down and confirm preservation compatibility.

name: AURE-BISA Natural Bisabolol
description: Naturally sourced alpha-bisabolol with a clear, low-odor profile for comfort-led skin, scalp and color-cosmetic formulations.
specs: Appearance: clear colorless to pale-yellow liquid
Low odor and easy oil-phase incorporation
applications: Sensitive-skin emulsions, balms, lip care, scalp treatments, after-shave, baby-care concepts and color cosmetics. Validate final claims and irritation profile.

name: AURE-SQ Sugarcane Squalane
description: A lightweight, highly stable sugarcane-derived emollient that improves slip, spreadability and after-feel without a heavy or greasy finish.
specs: Low odor and broad formulation compatibility
applications: Facial oils, emulsions, cleansers, lip products, foundations, hair serums and body care. Add to the oil phase or post-add where process permits.

name: AURE-EMUL O/W Emulsifier
description: A plant-derived nonionic oil-in-water emulsifier engineered for elegant creams and lotions with stable structure and a soft, conditioned skin feel.
applications: Face creams, body lotions, hair conditioners, masks and low-to-medium viscosity emulsions. Run stability, freeze-thaw and packaging-compatibility tests.

name: AURE-SOFT Silica Microspheres
description: Porous cosmetic-grade silica microspheres that provide soft-focus optics, improved slip and controlled oil absorption in powder and emulsion systems.
specs: Suitable for anhydrous and emulsion systems
applications: Pressed and loose powders, primers, foundations, sunscreen textures, dry shampoo and mattifying skincare. Control airborne dust during handling and validate dispersion.
